boardStatus.blueprintScope: The ABNM published in-training blueprint has 10 major classifications: Core, Cardiovascular, Endocrine, Gastrointestinal, Genitourinary, Musculoskeletal / Infection-Inflammation, Neurology, Oncology, Pulmonary and Therapy; Oncology is 34% in the published 125-question in-training blueprint.
boardStatus.notASeparateFellowshipBoardClaim: This course does not represent a nuclear radiology or PET/CT fellowship, and it makes no separate-board claim for any fellowship.

boardEligibilityNotice: Independent self-study cannot establish ABNM eligibility, ACGME completion, physician licensure, NRC/Agreement State authorized-user status, supervised procedure/case experience, clinical competence or board certification.
